summary_ja: パラメーター(p)の算式、リテールと事業法人等の混在、実効的な個数(N)、加重平均LGD、残存期間(M_{T})の算出方法を定める。
summary_en: Gives the formula for parameter (p) and the method of calculating the effective number of exposures (N), weighted average LGD and residual maturity (M_{T}), including simplified treatments.
paragraphs: The "parameter (p)" in the formula set out in Article 231 means the value calculated by the following formula. P = max[0.3, (A + B*(1/N) + C*K_{IRB} + D*LGD + E*M_{T})] N, LGD and M_{T} are each as follows, and A, B, C, D and E are as set out in the following table. N is the effective number of exposures (N) calculated under the provisions of paragraph (4) or (7). LGD is the weighted average LGD of the underlying assets (LGD) calculated under the provisions of paragraph (5) or (7). M_{T} is the residual maturity of the securitization exposure (M_{T}) calculated under the provisions of paragraph (8). {{T:p243t0}}

Where an IRB pool is composed of both retail exposures and corporate, etc. exposures, the parameter (p) shall be calculated using the formula in the preceding paragraph for each of the portion relating to retail exposures and the portion relating to corporate, etc. exposures, into which the pool is divided, and the value obtained by weighted-averaging them by the total notional amount of each type of exposure shall be the parameter (p) of that IRB pool.

Where, under the provisions of Article 228, paragraph (4) (limited to the portion relating to item (i)), the risk weight of a securitization exposure relating to a mixed pool is calculated using the IRB-based method, the parameter (p) shall be calculated for only the portion of the exposures of the underlying assets that satisfies all of the requirements in Article 1, item (lxxiii)(a) and (b).

The "effective number of exposures (N)" in the formula set out in paragraph (1) means the value calculated by the following formula. {{F:p244i0}} EAD_{i} is the EAD of the i-th exposure included in the underlying assets (multiple exposures to the same obligor are regarded as a single exposure).

The "weighted average LGD of the underlying assets (LGD)" in the formula set out in paragraph (1) means the value calculated by the following formula. {{F:p244i1}} LGD_{i} is the weighted average LGD of the i-th exposure (multiple exposures to the same obligor are regarded as a single exposure).

Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, where the underlying assets include purchased receivables and the credit enhancement mechanism provided by the seniority structure of the securitization exposure treats losses relating to default risk and losses relating to dilution risk of the underlying assets of that securitization exposure equally, the weighted average LGD of the underlying assets of that securitization exposure (LGD) shall be the value calculated by the formula set out in Article 150, paragraph (5).

Where the proportion of the exposure with the largest EAD among the underlying assets to the total amount of the underlying assets (C_{1}) is 0.03 or less, notwithstanding paragraphs (4) and (5), the effective number of exposures (N) may be the value obtained by the following formula, and LGD may be 0.50; provided, however, that where C_{m} other than C_{1} is not known, N may be 1/C_{1}. {{F:p245i0}} C_{m} is the proportion that the total EAD of the m exposures included in the underlying assets, taken in descending order of EAD, represents of the total EAD of those underlying assets.

The "residual maturity of the securitization exposure (M_{T})" in the formula set out in paragraph (1) shall be the period calculated using either of the following calculation methods (or one year where it is less than one year, and five years where it exceeds five years); provided, however, that the calculation method in item (i) may be used only where the cash flows allocated to the securitization exposure under the contract of the securitization transaction are determined unconditionally, independently of the performance of the original assets or other conditions. (i) The following calculation method based on the cash flows allocated to the securitization exposure under the contract of the securitization transaction: {{F:p245i1}} CF_{t} is the cash flow contractually paid to the holder of the securitization exposure in period t. (ii) The following calculation method based on the final legal maturity date of the securitization exposure: M_{T} = 1 + (M_{L} − 1) * 80% M_{L} is the period (in years) until the final legal maturity date of the securitization exposure.
